memberdef.name: ConstantFPRange

briefdescription.para: Initialize a range of values explicitly.

detaileddescription.para: Note: If LowerVal is greater than UpperVal, please use the canonical form [Inf, -Inf].

briefdescription.para: Does the predicate Pred hold between ranges this and Other?

detaileddescription.para: NOTE: false does not mean that inverse predicate holds!

briefdescription.para: Return the lower value for this range.
Return the upper value for this range.
Get the semantics of this ConstantFPRange.
Return true if this set contains all of the elements possible for this data-type.
Return true if this set contains no members.
Return true if the specified value is in the set.
Return true if the other range is a subset of this one.
If this set contains a single element, return it, otherwise return null.

detaileddescription.para: If ExcludesNaN is true, return the non-NaN single element.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this set contains exactly one member.

detaileddescription.para: If ExcludesNaN is true, return true if this set contains exactly one non-NaN member.

briefdescription.para: Return true if the sign bit of all values in this range is 1.

detaileddescription.para: Return false if the sign bit of all values in this range is 0. Otherwise, return std::nullopt.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this range is equal to another range.
Return true if this range is not equal to another range.
Return the FPClassTest which will return true for the value.
Print out the bounds to a stream.
Allow printing from a debugger easily.
Return the range that results from the intersection of this range with another range.
Return the smallest range that results from the union of this range with another range.

detaileddescription.para: The resultant range is guaranteed to include the elements of both sets, but may contain more.

briefdescription.para: Create empty constant range with the given semantics.
Create full constant range with the given semantics.
Helper for (-inf, inf) to represent all finite values.
Helper for [-inf, inf] to represent all non-NaN values.
Create a range which doesn't contain NaNs.
Create a range which may contain NaNs.
Create a range which only contains NaNs.
Produce the smallest range such that all values that may satisfy the given predicate with any value contained within Other is contained in the returned range.

detaileddescription.para: Formally, this returns a superset of 'union over all y in Other . { x : fcmp op x y is true }'. If the exact answer is not representable as a ConstantFPRange, the return value will be a proper superset of the above.
Example: Pred = ole and Other = float [2, 5] returns Result = [-inf, 5]

briefdescription.para: Produce the largest range such that all values in the returned range satisfy the given predicate with all values contained within Other.

detaileddescription.para: Formally, this returns a subset of 'intersection over all y in Other . { x : fcmp op x y is true }'. If the exact answer is not representable as a ConstantFPRange, the return value will be a proper subset of the above.
Example: Pred = ole and Other = float [2, 5] returns [-inf, 2]

briefdescription.para: Produce the exact range such that all values in the returned range satisfy the given predicate with any value contained within Other.

detaileddescription.para: Formally, this returns { x : fcmp op x Other is true }.
Example: Pred = olt and Other = float 3 returns [-inf, 3) If the exact answer is not representable as a ConstantFPRange, returns std::nullopt.

briefdescription.para: This class represents a range of floating-point values.
